vibe: Swiss Brutalism meets High-End Editorial. Raw, strict geometric grids, exposed structures, thick borders, contrasting serif and mono typography. Focus on truth, institutional confidence, and zero decoration.

layout.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) within hard-bordered containers. No border radius (rounded-none).
layout.grid: Visible, spreadsheet-style grid. 1px or 2px solid #0A0A0A borders (border-collapse style).
layout.reader_facing: Bento blocks, oversized typography, asymmetrical layouts within a strict visible grid. Thick horizontal rules.
layout.admin_dashboard: Strict control-room density. Spreadsheet-style grids. Utilitarian, mono-heavy.

components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none), thick borders, solid fills, sharp hover states with hard drop shadows (e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#0A0A0A]).
components.navigation: Sticky, thick bottom border, heavily utilizing JetBrains Mono for links.
components.tags: border border-foreground bg-white px-2 py-1 font-mono text-xs uppercase hover:bg-foreground hover:text-white transition-colors

images.description: Cable network, abstract data center for Cloud & Data articles
Server cable trays for Infrastructure and Backend deep dives
Weathered padlock on metal gate for Threats & Policy articles
Abstract AI brain sphere for Artificial Intelligence trends

accessibility_and_testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button'). Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Focus states must be 2px solid #E63946 offset rings.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the reader-facing site to enforce the Swiss brutalist bento/grid layout. Avoid standard Shadcn cards for articles; use bare divs with thick borders (border-2 border-foreground) and no radius.
Use Shadcn UI for the Admin CMS, but customize it: rounded-none, heavy borders, monospace data tables.
Do NOT use Inter. Use Chivo for headlines, Cormorant Garamond for elegant feature text, and JetBrains Mono for utility/metadata. Provide these font-families in tailwind.config.js.
Implement an explicit CSS grid layout where borders are exposed, reminiscent of a spreadsheet or a dossier. Tension is created through asymmetry and heavy typographic weight.
The primary CTA color is Signal Red (#E63946).
Images should ideally be stark, avoiding overly warm/corporate stock tones.
Use data-testid on every single button, input, tab, and navigation link.
